proposals.observation: The Daily Blog Post workflow failed at 06:09 UTC on 23 July. The content queue shows only 1 post queued against 47 published, meaning the pipeline is nearly empty and the failure is actively stalling the only remaining queued piece. No quiz sessions fired in 48 hours and no new signups are attributed, which is consistent with a broken top-of-funnel content engine. Restoring this workflow is the single highest-leverage action because every other metric depends on content reaching the site.
proposals.proposal: Inspect the Daily Blog Post workflow run logs from 2026-07-23T06:09:33Z, identify the failure step, and apply a targeted fix. The most common causes in Astro-based CI pipelines are: a missing or rotated API secret, a Node version mismatch after a runner image update, or a malformed frontmatter in the queued post file. Check the queued post's frontmatter first because that is a one-line fix with zero side-effects. If the failure is a secret rotation, regenerate the key in the relevant service and update the repository secret. Do not touch astro.config.mjs or package.json (both are blocked paths). The fix lives in the workflow YAML itself only if the failure step is a runner or environment configuration issue.

proposals.impact: convert highest-open-rate segment while attention is warm
proposals.observation: The Money Vigilance automation has the highest open rate of the three running sequences at 66.67% across 12 sends. That is 8 people who opened in the last 24-to-48 hours and are demonstrably engaged with their relationship to money right now. Money Vigilance subscribers tend to be anxious, over-controlling savers who earn steadily but cannot permit themselves to act. They read carefully. A sequence email that names this precisely, without fixing or cheerleading, will land harder than any cold traffic copy.
proposals.proposal: Add a new email to the end of the Money Vigilance sequence. The email should name the specific bind: the spreadsheet is always up to date, every subscription is audited, and yet the ISA sits at the same number it did eighteen months ago because looking at the money and doing something with the money feel like two completely different problems. No call to action that promises a fix. One specific invitation to book a single conversation with Joel. The subject line and body draft are in NEW_TEXT 2 below. File path is an approximation based on the automation name pattern; adjust to match the actual MailerLite export or local draft folder.
proposals.new_text:
Subject: You know exactly what's in your account. That's the problem.

You've checked the balance. Probably more than once today.

You know the number. You've known it for months. You track it in a spreadsheet most people would find alarming in its detail.

And the ISA is sitting at roughly what it was last January.

This is not a discipline problem. Joel sees it in almost every Money Vigilance client: the tracking is meticulous, the action is frozen. Knowing the number in granular detail can become a way of feeling in control without having to decide anything. The spreadsheet is always accurate. Nothing is ever quite certain enough to move.

If that sentence landed somewhere specific, a single conversation with Joel costs nothing. It's 45 minutes. No programme pitch, no follow-up sequence. Just an honest look at what's actually in the way.

Book it here: [CALENDAR LINK]

Joel
MSc Behavioural Economics | Qualified Financial Planner

proposals.impact: seed quiz sessions from existing organic visitors

The top_sources array is empty, which confirms no referral path is currently routing users to the quiz. The homepage is the most-visited owned page for any content-led site and is the correct place to add a direct, visible path to the quiz for visitors who arrive organically from the blog posts published in June.
